div.head: VIII Atr 40
div.ab: And gif man eard wille rihtlice clænsian, þonne mot man smeagan ⁊ geornlice spirian, hwar ða manfullan wununge habban þe nellað geswican ne for Gode betan, ac swa hwar swa hi man finde, gewilde he to rihte, þances oððe unðances, oððe hi afirsige mid ealle of earde, buton hi gebugan ⁊ to rihte gewændan.

And if the land is to be thoroughly purified, inquiry and search must be diligently made for the dwelling-places of the wicked who will not abstain [from evil] or make amends in the sight of God, and wherever they are found they shall be brought to justice, willingly or unwillingly, or they shall be utterly driven from the land, unless they submit and amend their ways.
